fusions.name: Bristling Snarl
fusions.desc: Snaps at everything close, which deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, each with a 20% chance of [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent on the Strands
fusions.desc: A snap that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Marked] for 8 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Winter Coat
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% and your frost resistance by 10% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Dark Pelt by Night
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
